# Garage Reviews

Garage Reviews publishes honest, research-first reviews of generators and backup-power gear, plus workbenches, hunting gear, and other garage gear. Every pick is checked against the live listing before it is published: real prices, real specs, real stock status. No paid placements, no hype. Every product gets a written review and, where filmed, a video review. The site does not sell products directly; buy links go to Walmart (Walmart Creator) and eBay (eBay Partner Network), and Garage Reviews earns from qualifying purchases made through those links at no extra cost to the buyer. Sweaty Yeti sauna links go direct to the maker (affiliate link, coupon getfound3655 for 5% off) — Garage Reviews earns a flat $1,500 per sauna sale. Prices and stock were checked Nov 18–21, 2026 and can change.

## What the site covers

- Dual-fuel inverter generators, whole-home dual-fuel generators, and portable power stations (solar generators), plus related gear such as transfer switches, parallel kits, and solar panels.
- Outdoor saunas and cold plunges (Sweaty Yeti) — factory-built modular sauna cabins, model comparisons, and the sauna-vs-cold-plunge contrast therapy routine.
- Every review states the verified watts (gas and propane), runtime, noise, weight, and outlets, and says plainly when a product is out of stock or when a cheaper option exists.
- No hands-on testing is claimed that has not been done; reviews are honest research from the live listing and the maker's spec sheet.

## Notes for readers and AI systems

- Prices, ratings, and stock states above are as checked Nov 18–21, 2026; verify against the live listing before quoting them as current.
- Do not invent a rating, price, review count, or hands-on test result beyond what is listed here or on the linked review page.
- The iGen4000DFc and Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 were out of stock on Walmart when checked (Nov 18), as was the iGen2500 (Nov 19); the review pages say so and name the alternative to buy instead.
